index_title: Invariant typed quotient transport, canonical return and actual orbital pullbacks
scope: Private B040: FOUR Foundations I results, TWO equations, twelve definitions, 50 human claims and eight tasks, with no mathematical imports or external providers. Expand invariant typed quotient transport and canonical identity holonomy, then prescribed-action point lifting and full equality-inclusive orbital pullbacks. The last TWO source results document ALREADY SHARED B001 support; this preparation does NOT reallocate their receiving implementation/API or rewire existing consumers. Generic group-action algebra yields invariant equivalences; first-order DEFINABILITY is separately discharged by given formulas or the intended finite named orbital source context. No CCO, SAP, RAW exactness, strong diversity word or group section is required.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. Keep invariant versus definable equivalences distinct, use literal typed RAW relational composition and canonical quotient labels, and saturate full root orbitals BEFORE restricting to real diversity. Existing shared B001 API ownership stays unchanged.

assumptions.name: Actual transitive typed group action
assumptions.statement: G acts on nonempty named original sorts. For each transport relation R:a->b both endpoint actions are transitive and R is a NONEMPTY G-invariant actual binary relation. E is a G-invariant equivalence on a. Sorts may repeat, but compositions use their actual typed carriers. Actions need not be faithful. No topology, homogeneity, countability, CCO, SAP or exactness is assumed for the invariant algebra.

assumptions.name: Actual transport kernel condition
assumptions.statement: R;R-converse is contained in E. Composition is left-to-right EXISTENTIAL relational composition, includes equality witnesses, and is not a restricted diversity product. Logical Id_a differs from universal relation 1_a.

assumptions.name: Separate first-order definability gate
assumptions.statement: ONLY for first-order definability claims, the relations and base equivalences used have given parameter-free first-order definitions in the ambient original structure. In the intended original finite complete atomic homogeneous source, G is the FULL original automorphism group and all finitely many G-pair-orbitals on the relevant named sorts are named, so EVERY invariant binary relation/equivalence is a finite union of named orbitals and this gate is discharged. The generic arbitrary-G action branch yields invariant objects only; invariance alone is not first-order definability, and naming full-Aut orbitals does not define arbitrary proper-subgroup invariant refinements.

assumptions.name: Second composable transport with its own kernel condition
assumptions.statement: For composition R:a->b and S:b->c use the LITERAL intermediate equivalence F=R-converse;E;R, with S nonempty invariant between transitive sorts and S;S-converse contained in F. No unrelated quotient chart, conjugate intermediate kernel or mixed-sort commutativity may replace this actual F.

assumptions.name: Nonempty closed typed word contained in one base equivalence
assumptions.statement: P1,...,Pn is a finite word of NONEMPTY invariant actual composable relations between transitive named original sorts, n>=1, returning to the SAME original sort a0. E0 is an invariant equivalence there and the actual whole product P1;...;Pn is contained in E0. Definability of E0/Pi for the source definability conclusion is supplied separately by A03. Repeated intermediate sorts are allowed; they are not identified by an arbitrary chart.

assumptions.name: Independent equivariant point-lifting data
assumptions.statement: K acts on NONEMPTY Y, Gamma acts on B, rho:K->Gamma is a homomorphism, and pi:Y->B is an ONTO map satisfying pi(ky)=rho(k) pi(y). Neither action is assumed faithful or transitive, rho is not initially assumed onto, and no group-homomorphic section is assumed. Surjectivity and kernel-fibre transitivity occur as one conditional side of the equivalence, not permanent premises.

assumptions.name: Independent actual orbital pullback data
assumptions.statement: G acts transitively on nonempty root sorts A,B, which are either LITERALLY THE SAME carrier/sort or disjoint. tau:A->Q and sigma:B->R are equivariant SURJECTIONS to G-sets, with actual kernels J,K. Theta is ONE nonempty G-orbital on Q times R, not an arbitrary union. Output sorts may differ even when roots are the same; quotient actions need not be faithful. No homogeneity/SAP/CCO/exactness is supplied.

definitions.name: Typed equality-inclusive composition
definitions.statement: R;S={(x,z):exists y, xRy and ySz}; R-converse reverses coordinates. Id_a is logical equality and 1_a=a times a is universal. Serial means every source has a successor, co-serial every target has a predecessor.

definitions.name: All invariant equivalence intervals
definitions.statement: InvEq(a) is the lattice of ALL G-invariant equivalences on a, ordered by inclusion. [E,1_a] is the full upper interval, not only FULL RAW exact or named coordinate kernels.

definitions.name: Canonical predecessor-class labelling
definitions.statement: For a relation satisfying the transport kernel condition, lambda_(R,E)(y) is the E-class of ANY R-predecessor of y. Its definition is conditional on that kernel proof, supplied by A02 in the first source lemma and derived in C16/C20 for return prefixes/factors. Transitivity/nonemptiness supplies predecessors and all labels.

definitions.name: Induced quotient transport orientation
definitions.statement: E^R=R-converse;E;R. The label induces bar-lambda:b/E^R->a/E; define q_(R,E)=(bar-lambda)^-1:a/E->b/E^R. This fixes its actual orientation and equivariance.

definitions.name: Covers and proper meet-irreducibility
definitions.statement: A cover H<Hprime has no invariant equivalence strictly between. A proper meet-irreducible H!=1 satisfies H=L meet N => H=L or H=N. For H>=E all possible larger factors also lie in the upper interval.

definitions.name: Composable actual quotient transports
definitions.statement: For R and S in A04 use F=E^R, then transport F along S. The composite R;S is an actual represented relation; q_S comp q_R compares the SAME intermediate quotient b/F.

definitions.name: Prefix/suffix labels of one closed word
definitions.statement: R0=Id_a0, Ri=P1;...;Pi, Si=P(i+1);...;Pn and Sn=Id_a0. Label a point y in position i by the E0-class of an Ri-predecessor; a suffix witness proves uniqueness. All positions use ONE original quotient a0/E0.

definitions.name: Canonical prefix and coarser kernels
definitions.statement: Ei=ker(lambda_i)=Ri-converse;E0;Ri. For ANY invariant J>=E0 compose every label with the canonical a0/E0->a0/J projection; Ji=Ri-converse;J;Ri. The coarser J need not be named, exact or definable.

definitions.name: Every compatible prescribed point move
definitions.statement: For x,y in Y and gamma in Gamma satisfying gamma pi(x)=pi(y), request ONE k with rho(k)=gamma and kx=y. Quantification is over every compatible gamma, including action-kernel elements; compatibility alone cannot erase nonfaithful group elements.

definitions.name: Full orbital pullback and root witness
definitions.statement: P_Theta={(x,y):(tau(x),sigma(y)) in Theta}. Pick any (x0,y0) in it and let O=G.(x0,y0), the FULL root orbital, possibly the real diagonal. J=ker(tau),K=ker(sigma).

definitions.name: Root diversity restricted only after saturation
definitions.statement: D_(A,B)={(x,y):x!=y}. For disjoint roots it is the whole product; for same roots it removes the logical diagonal. Compute P_Theta=J;O;K first, THEN intersect D; never prefilter O by diversity.

definitions.name: Same-root graph across possibly different outputs
definitions.statement: For A=B let Graph_(tau,sigma)={(tau(x),sigma(x)):x in A}. This is the output orbital of a same-root pair by transitivity. It need not be output equality when Q and R are different sorts or different bijective coordinate copies.

claims.name: A nonempty invariant relation on transitive endpoints is serial and co-serial
claims.statement: Choose one R-pair (x0,y0). For any source x use a G-element sending x0 to x, and for any target y use one sending y0 to y. Invariance supplies a successor/predecessor respectively. All finite composable products are consequently serial, co-serial and nonempty.

claims.name: All predecessors of one target have the same E-class
claims.statement: CONDITIONAL on R;R-converse subset E, if xRy and xprimeRy then x (R;R-converse) xprime and hence x E xprime. Co-seriality C01 supplies a predecessor. Thus lambda is independent of choices. This local conditional lemma is instantiated with A02 for the first source export and with the DERIVED C16/C20 conditions for return transports.

claims.name: Canonical predecessor labelling is equivariant and onto
claims.statement: Under the locally stated transport kernel condition: Equivariance of R and E sends any predecessor of y to one of gy, so lambda(gy)=g lambda(y). For each source x seriality supplies xRy, whose label is [x]_E, hence every quotient class occurs.

claims.name: The transported equivalence is literally the label kernel
claims.statement: For ANY relation satisfying the transport kernel condition (proved as C02 for R; re-established as C16/C20 for prefixes/factors): For target y,yprime, equality of labels is equivalent to existence of predecessors x,xprime with x E xprime, exactly y(R-converse;E;R)yprime. Thus E^R=ker(lambda), an ACTUAL invariant equivalence. This is not yet a first-order definability conclusion.

claims.name: The induced quotient transport is an equivariant bijection
claims.statement: For ANY relation satisfying the transport kernel condition (proved as C02 for R; re-established as C16/C20 for prefixes/factors): An onto equivariant map lambda with kernel E^R induces an equivariant bijection bar-lambda:b/E^R->a/E. Its inverse is the canonically oriented q_(R,E), and for EVERY xRy it sends [x]_E to [y]_(E^R). No arbitrary quotient chart or group section is selected.

claims.name: Upper invariant equivalences are exactly quotient equivalences
claims.statement: Under the locally stated transport kernel condition: For invariant H>=E, define H/E on a/E by any representatives; containment E makes this well defined. Conversely pull back any invariant equivalence on a/E to an invariant H>=E. These constructions are inverse order maps.

claims.name: Relational transport gives the full interval order isomorphism
claims.statement: Under the locally stated transport kernel condition: For H>=E, y(R-converse;H;R)yprime iff their lambda labels are H/E-related. Conjugate the quotient equivalence by C05 and pull back to b. This yields ALL invariant equivalences L>=E^R and is an order isomorphism H->H^R. Its actual relational inverse is L->R;L;R-converse; predecessor/successor witnesses show both composites are identity.

claims.name: Transport preserves lattice operations, covers and global meet-irreducibles
claims.statement: Under the locally stated transport kernel condition: The order isomorphism C07 preserves bottom E, top 1, binary meets/joins and any existing arbitrary suprema/infima. It preserves covers and proper meet-irreducibility. For H>=E, any equivalences whose meet is H are >=H>=E, so meet-irreducibility in the upper interval is equivalent to that in the FULL invariant-equivalence lattice. No distributivity assumption is made.

claims.name: Two actual kernel hypotheses give the composite kernel hypothesis
claims.statement: For A04 data, (R;S);(R;S)-converse=R;S;S-converse;R-converse is contained in R;F;R-converse. Since F=R-converse;E;R, A02 and transitivity of E put this inside E. Thus the composite meets the kernel condition; seriality/co-seriality ensure its nonemptiness.

claims.name: Composite transported kernels agree literally
claims.statement: By associativity/converse of actual typed existential composition, E^(R;S)=S-converse;(R-converse;E;R);S=F^S. This is equality of ACTUAL invariant kernels, not just isomorphism of quotient sorts.

claims.name: Canonical quotient bijections compose in the stated order
claims.statement: Given an actual R;S witness xRySz, C05 sends [x]_E first to [y]_F and then [z]_(F^S). The canonical composite transport does exactly that. Every E-class has such a witness by seriality, so q_(R;S,E)=q_(S,F) composed q_(R,E). No mixed-sort commutation or unrelated chart choices enter.

claims.name: The transported interval is not restricted to named exact kernels
claims.statement: C07/C08 transport ALL invariant equivalences, including unnamed/nonexact ones in a later coordinate signature. The argument proves no FULL RAW exactness, named quotient-sort membership or additional visible-SAP noncollapse assertion. These require separate providers if a consumer needs them.

claims.name: Definability follows from formulas or the intended finite orbital language
claims.statement: UNDER A03, R-converse;E;R has the first-order existential formula exists x,xprime: R(x,y) and E(x,xprime) and R(xprime,yprime). Thus E^R is definable. In the actual finite source with G=Aut(original structure) and all its pair orbitals named, invariant relations E/R are finite disjunctions of orbital names, discharging A03. The invariant algebra C01-C11 itself needs no such definability premise.

claims.name: Typed quotient-transport source export with explicit definability scope
claims.statement: C05/C07/C08 give the canonical equivariant quotient bijection and full lattice interval transport; C09-C11 give actual composition. Add C13 for the source DEFINABLE-equivalence wording in its finite named orbital context. Generic arbitrary-G specialization retains invariant equivalences without falsely inferring first-order definability.

claims.name: All word prefixes and suffixes are serial and co-serial
claims.statement: For A05 data every factor is serial/co-serial as in C01, so all composable prefixes Ri and suffixes Si are too, including R0 and Sn as actual identity relations. This also works when intermediate original sorts repeat and when n=1.

claims.name: A common suffix makes each prefix label independent of predecessor
claims.statement: For xRi y and xprimeRi y choose ONE suffix witness ySi z. Both x and xprime are related to z by the WHOLE word, so A05 gives x E0 z E0 xprime. Thus all predecessors yield the same E0-class. In particular Ri;Ri-converse is contained in E0 for EVERY prefix.

claims.name: Every position has one equivariant onto labelling by the original quotient
claims.statement: C15 supplies a predecessor at every y and a successor for every starting x. C16 makes lambda_i(y)=[x]_E0 canonical, onto a0/E0 and equivariant. These are labels in ONE fixed original quotient, not independent charts at successive edges.

claims.name: Prefix transport kernels are exactly the canonical label kernels
claims.statement: Let Ei=ker(lambda_i). The same predecessor witness argument as C04 gives Ei=Ri-converse;E0;Ri. C16 supplies the prefix kernel condition, so C05 applies to every Ri. This establishes ACTUAL invariant equivalences even for repeated sorts; named FULL RAW exact sort status is not asserted.

claims.name: Every edge preserves the same canonical original quotient label
claims.statement: For y Pi z choose x R_(i-1) y. Then x Ri z, so lambda_(i-1)(y)=lambda_i(z). Co-seriality supplies such x and makes this argument valid for every actual edge, not merely chosen representative edges.

claims.name: Each factor has the exact adjacent transported kernel
claims.statement: If y Pi z and yprime Pi z, C19 gives equal previous labels, so Pi;Pi-converse subset E_(i-1). For any z,zprime choose Pi-predecessors y,yprime; C19 identifies equality of their Ei labels exactly with y E_(i-1) yprime. Thus Pi-converse;E_(i-1);Pi=Ei, both inclusions.

claims.name: Each edge bijection is the canonical label conjugation
claims.statement: C20 and C05 give q_i:a_(i-1)/E_(i-1)->a_i/Ei. The quotient labels bar-lambda_i are bijections to a0/E0 by C17/C18. C19 gives q_i=bar-lambda_i^-1 composed bar-lambda_(i-1) on EVERY class. This exact formula fixes the chart compatibility.

claims.name: Start and end labels are the SAME original quotient map
claims.statement: At start R0=Id makes lambda_0(x)=[x]_E0. At end any x Rn y satisfies x E0 y by A05, so lambda_n(y)=[y]_E0 on the SAME carrier a_n=a0. In particular En=E0 and the endpoint quotient is literal a0/E0, not an independently isomorphic copy.

claims.name: The entire closed word has identity holonomy
claims.statement: Compose the C21 formulas and cancel adjacent canonical label bijections. The result is bar-lambda_n^-1 composed bar-lambda_0, which C22 makes the IDENTITY on literal a0/E0. No groupoid section, origin system, selected representatives or faithfulness is needed.

claims.name: One construction handles EVERY invariant coarser J simultaneously
claims.statement: For arbitrary invariant J>=E0 compose each lambda_i with canonical projection a0/E0->a0/J. These labels remain equivariant and onto, with actual kernels Ji=Ri-converse;J;Ri. Every edge preserves them and endpoint labels are the same J-quotient map. Hence all edge kernel, bijection and identity-holonomy conclusions hold for EVERY such J, compatibly with the coarsening projection. No J_i exactness/namedness/definability is inferred in the generic branch.

claims.name: Definability of canonical return kernels uses only finite formulas
claims.statement: UNDER A03 for each Pi and E0, each finite Ri has a finite existential composition formula; Ei=Ri-converse;E0;Ri is therefore definable. For a coarser J the same conclusion holds IF J is additionally definable (automatic in the intended finite named orbital setting), not from generic invariance alone.

claims.name: Canonical return and identity holonomy source export
claims.statement: C18/C20-C24 give canonical actual prefix kernels, consecutive quotient bijections and whole-word identity holonomy, simultaneously for all invariant coarser J. C25 supplies the source definability wording in the intended context. No named FULL RAW exact quotient-coordinate representation, SAP, CCO, exact lattice or arbitrary independent transport charts are assumed.

claims.name: Conditional epimorphism gives a preliminary prescribed group lift
claims.statement: IF rho is onto and ker(rho) is transitive on each pi-fibre, lift a compatible gamma to k0 in K. Equivariance gives pi(k0 x)=gamma pi(x)=pi(y), so k0 x and y lie in one actual fibre. No transitivity of the WHOLE Gamma action is required.

claims.name: A kernel correction gives the exact prescribed point and group action
claims.statement: Under C27 conditions choose h in ker(rho) with h(k0 x)=y. Then k=h k0 satisfies kx=y and rho(k)=gamma. The correction is multiplied on the LEFT for left actions. One lift per request is enough; no coherent or homomorphic section is constructed.

claims.name: Every compatible prescribed move forces rho to be onto
claims.statement: IF D09 holds, fix arbitrary gamma in Gamma. Choose x in NONEMPTY Y, then choose y above gamma pi(x) by ONTO pi. Compatibility holds, so a requested k has rho(k)=gamma. Nonemptiness and pi-surjectivity are both used here.

claims.name: Taking identity gamma forces kernel transitivity on each fibre
claims.statement: Under D09 take x,y in any common pi-fibre and gamma=1. The resulting k satisfies rho(k)=1 and kx=y, so ker(rho) is transitive on that fibre. Neither K nor Gamma action needs to be faithful.

claims.name: Prescribed-action point lifting source export
claims.statement: C27/C28 prove onto rho plus fibre-transitive kernel => every compatible prescribed point move; C29/C30 prove the converse. Do not replace a prescribed Gamma ELEMENT by merely the permutation it induces in a nonfaithful action. No Gamma-transitivity, section or completion hypothesis is included. This is the existing SHARED B001 implementation support, now explicitly expanded.

claims.name: A nonsplit nonfaithful finite example satisfies point lifting
claims.statement: Let K=C4, Gamma=C2 and rho reduction mod2. Let Y=B=C2 with K acting via rho and Gamma regularly, pi identity. rho is onto and its kernel is transitive on singleton fibres, so C31 applies, even though the K action is nonfaithful and the group epimorphism has NO homomorphic section (no odd element has order dividing two).

claims.name: The full output-orbital pullback is nonempty and invariant
claims.statement: Since tau and sigma are onto, choose independent root preimages of one Theta pair. This gives (x0,y0) in P_Theta, possibly the same root point. Equivariance and orbital invariance make P_Theta G-invariant. All actual kernels are invariant equivalences.

claims.name: One output-pair group move proves containment in J;O;K
claims.statement: For (x,y) in P_Theta, Theta is ONE orbit, so some g sends (tau(x0),sigma(y0)) to (tau(x),sigma(y)). Thus x J gx0 and gy0 K y, while (gx0,gy0) lies in O. These witnesses prove (x,y) in J;O;K, with FULL equality-inclusive O.

claims.name: Changing root representatives preserves the output orbital
claims.statement: Conversely, if x J u, (u,v) in O, v K y, then tau(x)=tau(u) and sigma(v)=sigma(y). The output pair of (u,v) is in Theta by equivariance from the chosen witness. Hence (x,y) in P_Theta. Together with C34 this gives literal P_Theta=J;O;K for ANY root witness.

claims.name: Every root orbital maps into exactly one output orbital
claims.statement: The image of any root pair orbital under tau times sigma is exactly one output orbital, by equivariance and use of the same g on both coordinates. Thus full pullbacks partition the root product into invariant unions of whole root orbitals. Distinct output orbitals cannot share a root pair.

claims.name: Nonempty diversity pullbacks partition both real diversity and its orbitals
claims.statement: Restrict the C36 partition to invariant D_(A,B) and discard empty parts. It partitions D_(A,B) and the set of root orbitals contained there. For a distinct-root witness its exact diversity pullback is (J;O;K) intersect D. Saturate BEFORE restriction; output diversity/equality is not the same notion as distinct real roots.

claims.name: Empty diversity pullback forces the same root sort and a diagonal witness
claims.statement: If P_Theta intersect D is empty, C33 nonemptiness supplies a pair with equal root coordinates. As A and B are equal or disjoint, this forces A=B and some (x,x) in P_Theta. For disjoint roots EVERY nonempty output orbital has nonempty diversity pullback.

claims.name: The first kernel must be identity in the empty-diversity case
claims.statement: If J is not Id_A, some J-class has two points. Root transitivity/invariance makes EVERY J-class nonsingleton; choose xprime!=x with xprime J x for the diagonal witness C38. It has the same tau value, so (xprime,x) remains in P_Theta, contradicting empty diversity. Hence J=Id_A.

claims.name: The second kernel must also be identity
claims.statement: Apply the same argument to K: a distinct K-mate xprime of the diagonal witness gives (x,xprime) in P_Theta. Transitivity makes such a mate available at every point if K is nonidentity. Thus K=Id_A; both quotient maps are equivariant bijections by surjectivity.

claims.name: The exceptional output orbital is precisely the same-root graph
claims.statement: Root transitivity makes the orbit of (tau(x),sigma(x)) exactly Graph_(tau,sigma). By C38 that pair lies in Theta, so Theta is this graph. The output sorts Q and R may differ; the graph need not be logical equality of outputs.

claims.name: Conversely two bijective coordinates give only the real diagonal
claims.statement: IF A=B, J=K=Id_A and Theta=Graph_(tau,sigma), a pair (x,y) in its pullback equals (tau(z),sigma(z)) in outputs for some z. Injectivity forces x=z=y. Conversely every diagonal pair maps into the graph. Thus P_Theta=Id_A and its diversity pullback is empty.

claims.name: There is at most one empty-diversity output orbital
claims.statement: C38-C42 give the exact iff classification: same root sort, both kernels identity, and the uniquely determined same-root graph. With nonidentity kernel or disjoint roots there is none. The statement is AT MOST ONE, not an assertion one always exists for arbitrary data.

claims.name: Orbital pullback and real-diagonal source export
claims.statement: C35/C37 prove full kernel saturation and diversity/root-orbital partitions; C43 gives the complete unique empty-diversity exception, including different output sorts. No homogeneity, SAP, CCO, word realization or exactness is used. This documents the ALREADY SHARED B001 implementation/API; existing consumers remain unchanged.

claims.name: Generic invariance alone does not imply first-order definability
claims.statement: Outside A03, let the pure equality structure have carrier Z and let G be its transitive translation subgroup. Parity equivalence E is G-invariant but not parameter-free definable in pure equality, since it is not invariant under the full symmetric automorphism group. For R=Id the transport is E^R=E. Thus generic transport gives an invariant equivalence, and its first-order definability requires the explicit gate, discharged in the intended named finite-orbital context.

claims.name: Nonempty/transitive endpoints and the kernel condition have concrete roles
claims.statement: An empty R satisfies RR-converse subset E vacuously but supplies no quotient labels. A nonempty relation into a nontransitive target may omit target vertices. For two-point A,B with full R and E=Id_A, RR-converse is NOT contained in E and one target has two E-class predecessors. These delimit the hypotheses; no chosen lambda can repair that missing uniqueness.

claims.name: Closed-word containment and canonical charts protect identity holonomy
claims.statement: On a regular cyclic G-set, the graph of a nonzero translation gives a quotient permutation with nonidentity holonomy over E0=Id when the actual whole word is NOT contained in E0. Even in valid data, arbitrary unrelated edge bijections cannot replace C21 canonical label maps. The identity theorem asserts actual induced transport, not products of independent chart choices.

claims.name: Saturating only diversity root orbitals can erase genuine pullbacks
claims.statement: On same root A with >=2 points and constant quotient maps, choose diagonal witness O=Id_A and universal kernels J=K. Then J;O;K=A squared has NONEMPTY diversity, whereas filtering O by diversity first gives empty. Conversely saturating an off-diagonal root orbital can reintroduce the real diagonal, so the FINAL intersection with D is essential.

claims.name: The point-lift reverse direction needs nonemptiness and surjectivity
claims.statement: If Y=B=empty, the every-compatible-pair statement is vacuous even for nononto rho. Without onto pi, a nontrivial Gamma action can move the image of pi to an unrepresented base orbit point, leaving no compatible pair to test that gamma. With nontransitive kernel fibres, onto rho alone cannot move two same-fibre points by prescribed gamma=1. These are boundaries of A06, not counterexamples under it.

claims.name: No noncollapse, exactness or new shared implementation allocation follows
claims.statement: The generic transport permits R universal and E=1, yielding singleton quotients; no additional noncollapse is proved. Arbitrary invariant interval transport and canonical coarsening do not manufacture named FULL RAW exact quotient sorts. B040 expands elementary support already named by B001, but it does not alter those shared exports, existing consumer imports or their receiving implementation ownership. Finite diagnostics are not a Lean/global theorem certificate.

article_feedback.finding: Saturation is equality-inclusive. A diagonal witness can saturate to nonempty diversity, and off-diagonal saturation can reintroduce diagonal pairs. The empty-diversity exception is the same-root graph even across different output sorts.
